text:
maria_dev: kicking off a cross-GPU sweep of the new "flashmix" attention kernel (mix of fused + paged heuristics). running A100/H100/L40S, seq sweep 512/1024/2048/4096, batch sweep 1/2/4. seeing odd throughput inversion on H100 at seq=4096 batch=1. attaching quick logs.
ashwin_ml: thanks — can you paste the small flame/profile snippet? curious if kv-cache spills show up.
maria_dev: pasted minimal output below
```
# bench cmd
./bench --model=vicuna-13b --kernel=flashmix --device=h100 --seq=4096 --batch=1 --kv-cache=true
Throughput: 12 toks/s
p50: 78ms p95: 210ms p99: 420ms
KV cache spill count: 27
Kernel path: flashmix -> fallback: paged_attn
GPU util: 42% (mem stall)
```
ashwin_ml: 12 toks/s is lower than expected. on A100 same config shows 18 toks/s and much fewer spills. suggests kernel choice triggered fallback often. do you have the runtime decision logs?
maria_dev: yes, snippet from kernel-decider: `seq_len>2048 && device_family==h100 -> prefer_paged_if_mem_pressure` but mem_pressure flag is noisy. also saw `kvcache_eviction=true` for a bunch of requests.

kai_infra: pinging infra: can we repro with perf harness that pins single job and disables multi-tenancy noise?
maria_dev: ran isolated harness on h100 node-42, same result. Also tried `--batch=2` and H100 matched A100 throughput closer (30 toks/s vs 32). suggests small-batch path has different kernel selection.
ashwin_ml: this smells like our batching heuristic threshold + kernel fallback interaction. if batch==1 we pick fused-paged variant which does expensive scatter, causing mem stalls on H100's page fault path.
perfbot: [auto] regression alert: h100 seq=4096 batch=1 throughput -33% vs baseline (2026-02-28). Related tests: attn/flashmix/*
maria_dev: repro steps I used:
```
# reproduce locally (isolated)
python -m ri.bench --model vicuna-13b --kernel flashmix --device h100 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --isolated
# logs: /tmp/bench-1925001234.log
```
kai_infra: I'll schedule a live repro on another H100 rack to rule out bad firmware. also can we toggle `--kv-cache=false` to see if spills are the main factor?
maria_dev: with kv-cache disabled throughput for h100 jumped to 20 toks/s (still below A100 but much improved). so kv-cache eviction seems to disproportionately hurt H100 in this kernel path.
ashwin_ml: action items:
- add finer-grained metric for mem-page-fault stalls in runtime (ashwin)
- tighten kernel-decision hysteresis for `mem_pressure` and `kvcache_eviction` (maria)
- infra to repro on second rack and check firmware/driver (kai)
- add an A/B: prefer fused variant on h100 for batch<=1 as a temporary rollback if perf improves (rollout via canary) (maria/kai)

deploy-bot: started canary rollout: attn-flashmix-try-fused-h100 (10% traffic) -> watch for errors and p99 regressions.
maria_dev: thanks all, I'll post a short followup with micro-profiles and heatmap of kernel choices across seq/batch/device.
ashwin_ml: also add a small eval prompt set to catch any quality regressions due to kernel fallback (we've seen subtle tokenization/order issues before). :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
maria_dev: noted. will include eval run in followup. :thumbsup:
